name: Kling v3 Motion Control
description: Kling AI Motion Control 3.0 transfers a reference video's motion to a character image, generating 3–30 seconds when matching the video orientation or up to 10 seconds when matching the image orientation, with optional prompt guidance and 720p or 1080p output.

examples.name: Animate a Character from Motion
examples.description: Create a character animation from a reference dance video at 720p.

input.prompt: Keep the character's gray T-shirt and denim shorts while matching the dancer's fluid movements.

code_snippets.label: typescript
code_snippets.code:
const response = await env.AI.run(
  'klingai/kling-v3-motion-control',
  {
    audio: 'off',
    character_orientation: 'video',
    image_url:
      'https://p2-kling.klingai.com/kcdn/cdn-kcdn112452/kling-qa-test/35d77e27300cf5e8995704cd858d759c.png',
    prompt:
      "Keep the character's gray T-shirt and denim shorts while matching the dancer's fluid movements.",
    resolution: '720p',
    video_url: 'https://v4-kling.kechuangai.com/kcdn/cdn-kcdn112452/kling-qa-test/dance_10s.mp4',
  },
)
console.log(response)

code_snippets.label: curl
code_snippets.code:
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/$CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID/ai/run \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{
  "model": "klingai/kling-v3-motion-control",
  "input": {
    "audio": "off",
    "character_orientation": "video",
    "image_url": "https://p2-kling.klingai.com/kcdn/cdn-kcdn112452/kling-qa-test/35d77e27300cf5e8995704cd858d759c.png",
    "prompt": "Keep the character'\''s gray T-shirt and denim shorts while matching the dancer'\''s fluid movements.",
    "resolution": "720p",
    "video_url": "https://v4-kling.kechuangai.com/kcdn/cdn-kcdn112452/kling-qa-test/dance_10s.mp4"

metadata.Audio: Preserve reference audio or disable it
metadata.Character Orientation: Match the reference video or image
metadata.Input Types: Character image, motion reference video, optional prompt

prompt.description: Optional prompt for scene and background details

image_url.description: Public URL of the character image (JPG or PNG)

video_url.description: Public URL of the motion reference video (MP4 or MOV)

character_orientation.description: Match character orientation to the reference video or image

audio.description: Keep the reference video audio or omit audio
